name: secret_list
description: List metadata for all secrets in z-mist matching the given filters. Returns secretKey, group, appName, namespace, secretType, encryptedValue (ciphertext, NOT plaintext), valueMd5 (fingerprint), keyVersion, expireTime, description, and timestamps. NEVER returns the decrypted value — use secret_get for that, or call IZMistSecretService.decryptValue() client-side. Backed by GET /api/secret/list. ZMistApplication runs on port 8080.

group.description: Filter by logical group, e.g. 'database'. Omit to see all groups.

appName.description: Filter by application, e.g. 'z-biz-news'. Omit to see all apps.

namespace.description: Filter by environment, e.g. 'prod'. Omit to see all environments.
